name: @intellectual-frontiers/rdf
description: RDF as algebraically typed values: IRIs, namespaces, typed vocabularies, class schemas, code lists, and the writers of N-Triples, N-Quads, canonical Turtle and JSON-LD; pure, no host, the same code on Bun, Node 26 and in a browser.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
